lead: A `-p <crate>` check whose fixture you found in another crate's tests can already have a twin in the target crate's own `#[cfg(test)]` module.
body: `crates/nvs-host/tests/limits.rs`'s `callable_of` is the visible builder of a registered handler, but `crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/hooks.rs`'s test module holds `hook_of`, which builds the same arity-1 callable out of `ClassTable`, `MethodRow` and the `CALLABLE_*` constants — all of them `nvs-runtime`'s own surface, so nothing has to move crates. Grep the crate the check names for `ClassTable::new` before concluding its `args` is the wrong half.
